## Overview

This knowledge-sharing seminar is a restitution of the FRB-CESAB intensive training course [**AI for Ecologists: A Toolkit**](https://ai-ecol.github.io/), supported by a mobility grant from **FR BioEEnViS**. The session bridges conceptual and epistemic foundations of AI/ML with an applied ecotoxicological case study, followed by an open inter-team discussion between ecotoxicologists and bioinformatics/AI researchers.

- **Date & Time:** Wednesday, December 16, 2026 · 09:30–11:45 CET
- **Format:** Hybrid
- **In-person:** Salle de formation Legay (3rd floor), LBBE – Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1
- **Online (Visio):** <https://visio.numerique.gouv.fr/icm-tmlx-fvj> *(access code shared via the FR BioEEnViS announcement email)*
